cards.claim: Frédérique Bitton was affiliated with the Centre de Recherche Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (CRPACA).
cards.quote: Avignon, France - In a significant development, our investigative team has uncovered conclusive evidence linking esteemed researcher Frédérique Bitton to the esteemed Centre de Recherche Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (CRPACA) in Avignon, France. According to multiple credible sources, including academic publications and institutional records, Frédérique Bitton was indeed affiliated with CRPACA, a leading research facility in the region. This revelation sheds new light on Bitton's illustrious career, which has been marked by groundbreaking contributions to her field. "We are thrilled to confirm that Frédérique Bitton was an integral part of our research community at CRPACA," said Dr. Marie-Pierre Lambert, Director of CRPACA.

raw_card.claim: Frédérique Bitton has been working at the University of Maiduguri.
